teams.claudeNote:
Claude (8 Nov): The team David has been playing for the last few days.

Claude (9 Nov, second check, built this team independently): Airborne comes from two heroes here. Reina adds about 0.89 of the gauge per rotation (Rising Cutter 0.24, Wind Slayer 0.40 with both charges, Wind Grab 0.25), Johnny about 0.6 (Venom Dance, Phantom Slash, Venom Cutter 0.20 each). With Burn, Poison and Airborne up, every hit gets +200% (x3).
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 600k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 630k with Kalsion's signature (Johnny: So Good It's to Die For, Reina: Become a Star in That Sky).
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 420k; 510k with Kalsion's signature.
teams.name: Airborne burst
teams.why: Reina keeps enemies Airborne almost whenever you want, which unlocks Kalsion's Explosion and Johnny's Venom Cutter. Johnny's Poison comes on top. Two Sub-DPS and an Enabler.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov, built this team independently): Charlotte applies Poison herself on 4 skills (Test 01: Poison Dagger 0.50, clone explosion 0.24, Illusion Kick 0.15, Poison Step 0.08), so Johnny's Poison is mostly redundant here. His real value is Airborne (about 0.6 per rotation) for Shadow Grab, plus his own damage. Her only own Airborne is Illusion Kick (0.20) on a long cooldown, which is why the agreed rating says she needs it.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 680k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 700k with Charlotte's signature. With her signature a 600k+ run is more reliable.
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 440k; 560k with Charlotte's signature.
teams.name: Shadow Poison
teams.why: Charlotte's Illusion Kick needs Poison or Stealth and her Shadow Grab needs Airborne. Johnny brings Poison and some Airborne, Reina brings the rest, so Charlotte can spend her time picking targets in Stealth.

teams.claudeNote:
Claude (8 Nov): David plans team tests with Roxy; Roxy may count as Sub-DPS here.

Claude (9 Nov check): her own sources per Test 01: Celestial Verdict 0.20 Stun (0.25 in Heretic Judgment), Consecration 0.15 Bleed plus 0.12 from the 10 s aura. Too slow on a boss, which is why she needs an enabler (David's rule: a hero who applies their own needs slowly still needs an enabler). Castella's Stun Blow (0.33) only works on a broken boss.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 330k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 400k with Theresia's signature; 350k with only Roxy's; 420k with both.
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 250k.
David: hard team (big run-to-run spread).
teams.name: Holy Bleed
teams.why: Theresia's Divine Arc needs Stun and her Holy Rise needs Bleed. She applies both herself, but slowly on a boss, so she needs an enabler to reach her full potential fast: Roxy adds both, and Theresia's Stun in turn opens Roxy's Kick Storm. Castella breaks Super Armor fast, which opens her own Stun. One damage dealer and two Enablers.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov check): Cerese shatters Othello's Ice Prison if she's played after him (David confirmed), and lifts his Knockdown targets, so she works against his setup. Dana is now rated higher than Othello (A vs B). My version without Cerese is t14, Ice Prison.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 300k with Season of Bitter Cold on all three; 350k with Othello's signature; 430k with Othello's and Cerese's; 480k with all three signatures.
teams.name: Deep Frost
teams.why: Othello's Frozen Burst needs Frozen enemies. Dana stacks Frost fast and Chako keeps fighting while she's swapped out; Cerese gathers with her tornado and adds Frost. Othello doesn't strictly need either of them, so this is about speed.

teams.claudeNote:
Claude (8 Nov): Ryza can stack Shock alone, so check whether Tarte's opener actually speeds her up.

Claude (9 Nov check): David confirmed the orbs keep coming after Tarte swaps out. The old "full Shock stack in about 17–18 s" came from a Lv.1 estimate in the superseded Test 01 entries, so it stays out until it's measured at Lv.70 (the Lv.70 Test 01 has her charged Skill at 0.90 Shock with all 26 orbs).
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 380k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 430k with Ryza's signature.
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 330k after runs of 250k and 300k (the Expert tag at its best, and still could do more); 400k with Ryza's signature.
teams.name: Storm
teams.why: Tarte builds Shock fast, and her Bolt Bubble keeps casting after she swaps out, so orbs keep coming while the main damage dealer is on the field; a Shock attack from any ally explodes them for big damage and more Shock, so Ryza's Shock hits detonate them. Sion adds team Attack (+15% at Lv.10, while a relic is placed) and more Shock. Ryza's Thunder Grab needs Shock.

teams.claudeNote:
Claude (8 Nov): David wants to see whether Ryza and Ornette work together at all.

Claude (9 Nov, built this team independently): all three apply Shock, and Knockdown comes from three sources (Ryza's Thunder Grab 0.20–0.25, Ornette's Judgment 0.25, or 0.40 at 2 Shock stacks, Sion's Divine Smash and Justice Fall 0.20 each). Shock and Knockdown give +150% on hits. Almost no Airborne: Ryza's Stormbringer 0.20, and Ornette's Holy Grab didn't apply it on the boss.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 500k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 550k with Ryza's signature; 540k with only Ornette's; 580k with both.
teams.name: Thunder pair
teams.why: Ornette's Judgment needs Shock and her Holy Grab needs Knockdown. Ryza supplies Shock, Sion supplies Shock and Knockdown plus the Attack buff.

teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 490k with Kalsion on The Burning Taste of Fire; 520k with his signature. Kalien on her signature in both runs (her own gain is known from other tests).
teams.name: Burn chain

sig.label: Kalsion's; Kalien's on in both runs

teams.why: A Burn team without Reina. Aria applies Burn and Airborne, Kalien stacks more Burn. Kalsion's Burst Grab needs Burn and his Explosion needs Airborne, both covered.

teams.claudeNote: A variant of Burn chain for bosses with a big Super Armor gauge.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 430k with Kalsion without his signature; 460k with Kalsion and Kalien both on their signatures.
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 330k; 380k with Kalsion's and Kalien's signatures.
teams.name: Break and burn
teams.why: Kalien's Fox Grab needs Break, and Castella breaks Super Armor fastest. Castella's Upper Blow then launches the enemy, giving Kalsion the Airborne for Explosion.

teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 650k with Kalsion's signature on (Kalien and Reina on normal Lv.1 Karmas); 700k with Kalien's signature too. Kalsion's own signature gain is measured in team 1.
No Karma at all (9 Nov): 390k and 460k (two runs); 560k with Kalsion's and Kalien's signatures.
teams.name: Fox and wind

sig.label: Kalien's; Kalsion's signature on in both runs

teams.why: David's own test: Kalien's Burn and Reina's Airborne both feed Kalsion.

teams.claudeNote:
Claude (8 Nov): Holy Bleed with Castella: 250k with no signatures, 350k with Theresia's and Roxy's.

Claude (9 Nov, built this team independently): Kalien's Finale gives Stun (0.20) with no condition, and her Burn adds a second damage-over-time status: Bleed, Burn and Stun give +200% on hits. Her Fox Grab needs Break and nobody here is a Breaker, but Kalien (25 s) and Theresia (27 s) break the gauge fast alone.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 320k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 450k with all three signatures.
No other Karma (9 Nov): 380k with only Theresia's signature; 350k with Theresia's and Kalien's; 500k and 430k with all three.
David: hard team (big run-to-run spread).
teams.name: Holy Bleed with Kalien
teams.why: Holy Bleed with Kalien in Castella's slot: Kalien's Finale adds Stun with no condition, plus Burn.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov): Aria alone gives about 0.4 Airborne per rotation (Air Bomb 0.20, Rolling Bomb 0.10, Switch On! 0.10), less than half of Reina's 0.89. With Johnny's 0.6 the two together come close to Reina, and Aria adds Burn (about 0.65 per rotation). Burn, Poison and Airborne: +200% on hits. Frees Reina for another team.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 420k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 450k with Kalsion's signature.
teams.name: Fire and venom
teams.why: Airborne burst without Reina. Aria applies both statuses Kalsion needs (Burn for Burst Grab, Airborne for Explosion); Johnny adds Airborne for both Explosion and his own Venom Cutter, plus Poison.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov): a variant of Nightmare support (t09) with Sion instead of Alex. Alex's parry is about +11% team damage on a 1000-Defense boss and needs exact timing. Sion's +15% Attack needs a relic placed but no timing, and he adds statuses. Only one Expert here (Eileen). Teammates must stand in the buff circles.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 370k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 410k with Ryza's signature.
teams.name: Double blessing
teams.why: Ryza covers her own needs, so both partners add damage: Sion's Bless and Eileen's Brave One each give +15% Attack (Lv.10) and add together, the banner gives +20% Crit Rate, and Sion adds Shock and Knockdown.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov): Deep Frost (t04) without Cerese, since she breaks Othello's prison and Frozen enemies, and with Dana as the Main DPS (rated A, Othello B). Measured: Dana broke the whole gauge in about 7 s after Othello's Ultimate. Knockdown and Shock: +150% on hits, plus +50% while Frozen.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 300k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 340k with Othello's signature.
David: feels terrible. Sion can't apply enough Shock on his own without a weird rotation that costs a ton of damage.
teams.name: Ice Prison
teams.why: Othello's Ice Crown makes the Ice Prison (about 20 s); Dana's Chako Knuckle on Ice Block hits 35% of the Super Armor gauge each, up to 4 in one prison. Sion adds Knockdown for Dana's Chako Spin, Shock, and team Attack.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov): Break and burn (t08) with Astria in Castella's slot. Weak spot: little Airborne for Kalsion's Explosion (only his own Burst Grab 0.25 and Royal Flame's Flame Wave 0.20), where Castella adds Upper Blow (0.33 Airborne). Worth one run to see whether Astria's own damage makes up for it.
teams.davidNote:
Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 380k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 400k with Kalsion's signature.
David: very easy to break. Discovery: Astria's Ultimate needs very little Rage; 3 basic attacks in Precision Shot mode give it back.
teams.name: Fox and crossbow
teams.why: Kalien and Astria unlock each other: Kalien's Finale gives Stun, which Astria's Bolt Bombard needs; Astria breaks Super Armor in about 18 s, which Kalien's Fox Grab needs. Both feed Kalsion Burn.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (9 Nov): untested question: does Airborne keep or end Frozen and Ice Blocks? If it ends them, swap Reina for Sion. Dana groups S, Cerese groups A, Reina groups S+.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 490k with normal Lv.1 Karmas; 530k with Cerese's signature.
teams.name: Frost tornado
teams.why: For groups. Cerese gathers with Ice Storm; her Frozen Needles needs Airborne and Frost, which Reina and Dana supply. Dana's Frost brings enemies to Frozen for Cerese's Shattering Touch.

teams.claudeNote: Claude (10 Nov): added from David's signature test runs; this team wasn't in the planner.
teams.davidNote: Lv.70, no gear, 1 min: 360k with normal Lv.1 Karmas (Sion: The One Chosen by Lightning, Castella: Destruction is the Mother of Creation); 410k with Ryza's signature. With it the boss ends each rotation on a full Shock stack; without, at about 75%. Expert team, could still do better.
teams.name: Lightning break
teams.why: Ryza's Thunder Grab needs Shock, which she and Sion apply. Castella breaks the boss fast, which doubles physical build-up, then Stuns it; Sion adds team Attack and Knockdown.

sigs.effect: When casting Guard Stance, Super Armor resistance is increased by 100% for a set time. While in Defensive Stance mode, damage taken by you and allies within range is reduced by 10% (same at minimum and max).
sigs.why: David: doesn't help him with anything.

sigs.effect: When the Switch On! skill is used, a larger explosion occurs, inflicting additional Burn and Airborne status effects on hit enemies.
sigs.why: A bigger Switch On! explosion that adds Burn and Airborne: more application for an Enabler.

sigs.effect: In Precision Shooting mode, the Ballista Shot skill changes to a charge action, allowing you to unleash a powerful single shot by holding down the skill key to fire all loaded arrows.
sigs.why: Her charged shot of all loaded arrows may be the fix for her single target and Stun. David thinks she needs it.

sigs.effect: The Howling skill has been changed to a Hold Action, so holding the skill key increases the skill duration.
sigs.why: Howling becomes a hold action for a longer duration.

sigs.effect: When the Ice Storm skill ends, the storm moves toward the nearest enemy. If the targeted enemy is defeated, the storm remains at that location.
sigs.why: Her Ice Storm moves to the nearest enemy when it ends.

sigs.effect: The Invisible skill is changed: reusing the skill instantly detonates the summoned Clone.
sigs.why: Changes her playstyle: re-using Invisible detonates the clone at once. Worth seeing on an Expert Main DPS.

sigs.effect: When Chako is summoned, frost spikes rise at the summoning point depending on the size of the Ice Clump on Chako's back. The frost spikes deal continuous damage to the target and inflict the Frost status effect.
sigs.why: David: not a must, and it needs enemies grouped first.

sigs.effect: When using the Banner Maid skill within the area created by the Brave One skill, Critical Rate and Critical Damage are further increased.
sigs.why: Already S. More Crit inside Brave One, so strong but not urgent.

sigs.effect: When using the Phantom Slash skill, blades are generated along the path, dealing additional damage to enemies within the area and inflicting the Poison status effect on hit.
sigs.why: Phantom Slash leaves blades that add damage and Poison.

sigs.effect: The number of foxes summoned by the Fox Grab skill increases.
sigs.karma: The Chosen One of the Crimson Flame
sigs.why: The tier list already marks her as needing it: more foxes from Fox Grab, her key skill.

sigs.effect: The attack range and damage of the Explosion skill are increased.
sigs.why: Explosion is his main damage. More range and damage on an A-tier hero that sits in several Airborne teams.

sigs.effect: The number of relics summoned by the Relic Fall skill increases.
sigs.karma: A Sword Summoned for a Friend
sigs.why: More relics from Relic Fall.

sigs.effect: When using the Holy Cross skill within the area created by the Holy Circle skill, the cross becomes larger and the number of attacks increases.
sigs.why: Holy Cross gets bigger with more hits inside Holy Circle.

sigs.effect: Frozen Stinger is enhanced: the range and damage of its final attack are increased. Pressing the attack button again casts the final attack faster.
sigs.karma: The Spear That Fells the Sun
sigs.why: Frozen Stinger's final hit gets bigger and faster.

sigs.effect: The Tempest skill changes to emit a sword aura.
sigs.karma: The Wind That Protects the Kingdom
sigs.why: Already S. Tempest becomes a sword aura.

sigs.effect: The number of arrows fired by the Kick Storm skill increases.
sigs.why: More arrows from Kick Storm, her Stun-gated skill.

sigs.effect: After using the Flash skill, pressing the attack key again unleashes a powerful thrust attack.
sigs.why: Adds a new thrust attack after Flash on our strongest Main DPS.

sigs.effect: When retrieving the sacred relic, a set amount of Rage for the Divine Crash and Divine Smash skills is restored.
sigs.why: Restores some Rage when retrieving the relic.

sigs.effect: When the Cure skill is used, the magic circle that appears remains active for a certain period and expands in range. It immediately removes physical status effects from allies within the magic circle's range and continuously heals them.
sigs.karma: A Helping Hand for Good Kids
sigs.why: David: not needed. It only improves her heal.

sigs.effect: The damage of the Divine Arc skill is increased. When entering Heretic Judgment mode, movement speed increases, and Theresia's Bleed attacks inflict an additional Bleed status effect.
sigs.notes: 9 Nov (Lv.70, no gear, 1 min): Theresia-Roxy-Kalien 380k with only her signature on; Theresia-Roxy-Castella 250k with none and 350k with hers and Roxy's. Not yet measured alone: the same team with and without only her signature. Claude's maths for the Karma's Lv.1 stats (Attack +80 on her 1245, Defense Ignore 2% on the Training Ogre's 1000 Defense, Bleed / Stun Additional Attack Power +105 / +210 while those statuses are up): her own hits +7.5% with no status, +16% with Bleed up, +33% with Bleed and Stun up.
sigs.why: David: not needed, but a big boost to Heretic Judgment.
